extracted.intended_audience: GAP users and package authors (people installing, configuring, and running GAP)
extracted.subtask_description: Reference guidance for running, configuring and customizing GAP: command-line options, startup files (gap.ini, gaprc), user preferences, workspace save/load, and UI features like ColorPrompt. Covers debugging and automated-testing options as well as memory and package path settings.

rubrics_metrics.name: -A (toggle suggested packages)
rubrics_metrics.description: By default, some needed and suggested GAP packages (see 76) are loaded, if present, into the GAP session when it starts. This option disables (actually toggles) the loading of suggested packages.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful for debugging/testing; needed packages (and their needed packages) are loaded in any case.

rubrics_metrics.name: -b (suppress banner)
rubrics_metrics.description: tells GAP to suppress the banner. That means that GAP immediately prints the prompt.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This option can be repeated to enable the banner; each -b toggles the state of banner display. Useful if you get tired of the banner.

rubrics_metrics.name: -c gapcode (execute code)
rubrics_metrics.description: tells GAP to execute the given GAP code as if it was entered into a temporary file which then is processed together with the other files given to GAP.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Commands specified via -c are processed in order with other files; see filename processing rules for error handling.

rubrics_metrics.name: -D (debug messages while reading files)
rubrics_metrics.description: The -D option tells GAP to print short messages when it is reading files or loading modules.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: May be repeated to toggle behavior. Example messages show whether files are loaded as GAP file, statically or dynamically; primarily a debugging option that most users will not need.

rubrics_metrics.name: -E (toggle readline usage)
rubrics_metrics.description: If your GAP installation uses the readline library for command line editing, this may be disabled by using -E option. This option may be repeated to toggle this behavior on and off.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If GAP wasn't compiled with readline support, this option has no effect (check IsBound(GAPInfo.UseReadline)).

rubrics_metrics.name: -e (ignore CTRL-D quit)
rubrics_metrics.description: tells GAP not to quit when receiving a CTRL-D on an empty input line.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Should not be used when input is a file or pipe. This option may be repeated to toggle this behavior on and off.

rubrics_metrics.name: -f (enable line editing/history)
rubrics_metrics.description: tells GAP to enable the line editing and history.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In general line editing will be enabled if input is connected to a terminal; use -f to force when detection fails; this option does not toggle (use -n to disable).

rubrics_metrics.name: -g (garbage collection messages)
rubrics_metrics.description: tells GAP to print a message every time a full garbage collection is performed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Available only with the GASMAN garbage collector. Provides counts of live/dead/free objects/KB; useful for debugging memory behavior.

rubrics_metrics.name: -g -g (detailed GC messages)
rubrics_metrics.description: If you give the option -g twice, GAP prints an information message every time a partial or full garbage collection is performed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prints both partial and full GC stats; available only with GASMAN.

rubrics_metrics.name: -h / --help (print options summary)
rubrics_metrics.description: tells GAP to print a summary of all available options. GAP exits after printing the summary; options after are ignored.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standard help listing for command-line options.

rubrics_metrics.name: -K / --limitworkspace (do not allocate more memory)
rubrics_metrics.description: is like the -o option, but while -o actually allocates more memory if the system allows it and then prints a warning, -K tells GAP not even to try to allocate more memory. Instead GAP just exits with an appropriate message.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Default is switched off; set explicitly to enable; contrasts with -o which permits later doubling inside break loop.

rubrics_metrics.name: -L filename (load workspace)
rubrics_metrics.description: The option -L tells GAP to load a saved workspace.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Workspace files are binary snapshots (see SaveWorkspace). Loading a workspace reduces startup time; only supported when GASMAN is used.

rubrics_metrics.name: -l path_list / --roots (set root directories)
rubrics_metrics.description: can be used to set or modify GAP’s list of root directories. path_list should be a list of directories separated by semicolons. No whitespace permitted before/after semicolon. Special semantics for leading/trailing semicolons (replace, append, prepend).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Default root is current directory './'. Often used in startup scripts to specify GAP installation root or to add user-specific root directories. After startup, GAPInfo.RootPaths shows the list. If GAP cannot find lib/init.g in any root it warns and you must restart with correct -l.

rubrics_metrics.name: --packagedirs path_list (add package directories)
rubrics_metrics.description: can be used to add paths to GAP’s list of package directories. path_list is a semicolon-separated list (no whitespace, cannot start or end with semicolon).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful to tell GAP about additional packages without a full root directory; after startup, GAPInfo.PackageDirectories shows the list.

rubrics_metrics.name: -M (disable use of compiled library files)
rubrics_metrics.description: tells GAP not to check for, nor to use, compiled versions of library files.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This option may be repeated to toggle this behavior on and off.

rubrics_metrics.name: -m / --minworkspace memory (initial memory allocation)
rubrics_metrics.description: tells GAP to allocate memory bytes at startup time. memory may end with k/K, m/M, g/G for kilobytes/megabytes/gigabytes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Should be large enough to avoid frequent garbage collections but not exceed physical memory (paging). Interacts with -o and -K.

rubrics_metrics.name: -n (disable line editing/history)
rubrics_metrics.description: tells GAP to disable the line editing and history.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful when command line editing is incompatible with other programs (e.g., Emacs shell which would echo lines twice). This option does not toggle; use -f to enable.

rubrics_metrics.name: -O (disable loading obsolete variables)
rubrics_metrics.description: disables loading obsolete variables (see Chapter 77).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mainly used for testing to ensure code does not rely on obsolete variables.

rubrics_metrics.name: -o / --maxworkspace memory (maximum allocated memory)
rubrics_metrics.description: tells GAP to allocate at most memory bytes without asking. If more than this amount is required during the GAP session, GAP prints an error message and enters a break loop.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Inside the break loop entering return; implicitly doubles the amount given with this option.

rubrics_metrics.name: -q (quiet mode)
rubrics_metrics.description: tells GAP to be quiet. GAP displays neither the banner nor the prompt gap>.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful for running GAP as a filter with input/output redirection to avoid banner/prompts in output. This option may be repeated to disable quiet mode; each -q toggles quiet mode.

rubrics_metrics.name: -R (do not load saved workspace)
rubrics_metrics.description: tells GAP not to load a saved workspace previously specified via the -L option.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This option does not toggle.

rubrics_metrics.name: -r (ignore user configuration)
rubrics_metrics.description: tells GAP to ignore any user specific configuration files. In particular, the user specific root directory GAPInfo.UserGapRoot is not added to the GAP root directories and so gap.ini and gaprc files in that directory are not read.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Multiple -r options toggle this behaviour.

rubrics_metrics.name: -s memory (use mmap/malloc instead of sbrk)
rubrics_metrics.description: With this option GAP does not use sbrk to get memory from the operating system. Instead it uses mmap, malloc or some other command for the amount given with this option to allocate space for the GASMAN memory manager.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assumes OS assigns physical memory only when accessed; -m, -o, -K still work. Useful for working with kernel modules that allocate a lot of memory with malloc.

rubrics_metrics.name: -T (suppress break loops, for testing)
rubrics_metrics.description: suppresses the usual break loop behaviour of GAP. With this option GAP behaves as if the user quit immediately from every break loop, and also suppresses displaying any error backtrace.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Intended for automated testing. This option may be repeated to toggle behavior.

rubrics_metrics.name: --version (print version)
rubrics_metrics.description: tells GAP to print its version and then exit immediately; options after are ignored.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standard version flag.

rubrics_metrics.name: -x / --width (screen width)
rubrics_metrics.description: With this option you can tell GAP how long lines are; GAP uses this to decide when to split long lines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Default is 80 unless obtained from OS. Use SizeScreen to alter after startup.

rubrics_metrics.name: -y / --line length (screen height)
rubrics_metrics.description: With this option you can tell GAP how many lines your screen has; GAP uses this to decide after how many lines of on-line help it should wait.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Default is 24 unless obtained from the OS. Use SizeScreen to alter after startup.

rubrics_metrics.name: filename ... (startup file processing rules)
rubrics_metrics.description: Further arguments are taken as filenames read by GAP during startup, after system and private init files are read, but before the first prompt. Filenames ending with .tst are processed by Test, all other files by Read. These files and -c commands are processed in the order given on the command line.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a file cannot be opened or executing the code raises an error, Read/Test error handling kicks in. If this enters a break loop, exiting that break loop also exits GAP.

rubrics_metrics.name: gap.ini (early startup configuration)
rubrics_metrics.description: The file gap.ini is read early in the startup process. Therefore parameters set here can influence startup (which packages are auto-loaded, whether obsolete variables are read). Usually should only contain calls of SetUserPreference.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only a restricted set of GAP functions may be called (assignments of numbers, lists, records, basic functions). This file is read whenever GAP is started (with or without a workspace). Use WriteGapIniFile to generate/update it.

rubrics_metrics.name: gaprc (late startup customization)
rubrics_metrics.description: The file gaprc is read after the startup process, before the first input file given on the command line. All GAP library functions can be called in this file. Only one gaprc file is read; when a workspace is created after gaprc was read, subsequently starting from that workspace will not re-read a gaprc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use gaprc for complex initialization that cannot be in gap.ini; ensure file is named exactly gaprc (Windows editors may append .txt).

rubrics_metrics.name: SetUserPreference / UserPreference (user preferences mechanism)
rubrics_metrics.description: User preferences are specified via a pair of strings: package name (case insensitive) and preference name; SetUserPreference sets a value; UserPreference returns the current value or fail if not known/set. Default package is 'GAP' if none given.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stored values are immutable. Use ShowUserPreferences to view known preferences; BrowseUserPreferences (Browse package) to edit. WriteGapIniFile creates a gap.ini with calls for non-defaults.

rubrics_metrics.name: WriteGapIniFile (create gap.ini)
rubrics_metrics.description: WriteGapIniFile (usually without argument) creates gap.ini in the user-specific GAP root directory, backing up an existing file first. The created file contains descriptions of known user preferences and calls to SetUserPreference for preferences that are not at their default value.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Optional dir argument to specify output directory; optional boolean true to ignore current session settings when creating file.

rubrics_metrics.name: Value restrictions for gap.ini (basic types only)
rubrics_metrics.description: Because gap.ini is read very early during startup, the value argument in SetUserPreference in gap.ini must be some very basic GAP object, usually a boolean, number, string or a list of those.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a user preference requires a more complicated value (e.g., a record only available after a package loads), move SetUserPreference call to gaprc.

rubrics_metrics.name: DeclareUserPreference(record) (declaring preferences)
rubrics_metrics.description: Declares a user preference and determines a default value and documentation. The record argument must contain components: name (string or list), description (list of strings), default (value or function). Optional components: check (validation function), values (admissible values), multi (allow multiple choices), package (package name), omitFromGapIniFile (boolean).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When declaration evaluated it sets default if not already set; do not use fail as default value; declared preferences show up in ShowUserPreferences and WriteGapIniFile.

rubrics_metrics.name: SaveWorkspace(filename) (save session snapshot)
rubrics_metrics.description: SaveWorkspace saves a snapshot image of the current GAP workspace in filename. The image can be loaded by another GAP which will then behave as at the point when SaveWorkspace was called.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Can only be used at the main gap> prompt. Cannot be included in the body of a loop or function, or called from a break loop. Recommended workflow: create a workspace after installing GAP and load it to reduce startup time; admins of shared installations should provide a workspace.

rubrics_metrics.name: ARCH_IS_* (system architecture tests)
rubrics_metrics.description: Functions to test platform: ARCH_IS_UNIX() tests UNIX (including macOS). ARCH_IS_MAC_OS_X() tests macOS (implies ARCH_IS_UNIX true). ARCH_IS_WINDOWS() tests Windows without POSIX tools. ARCH_IS_WSL() tests Windows Subsystem for Linux (WSL).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use these tests to write OS-specific behaviors; note WSL often behaves like Linux and ARCH_IS_UNIX will be true in WSL.

rubrics_metrics.name: GAPInfo (global session control record)
rubrics_metrics.description: GAPInfo is a global record containing components that control the GAP session (command line, architecture, info about available/loaded packages etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Components are typically set/read in low-level functions; changing existing components by hand is not recommended. Important components are documented via index entries (use ??GAPInfo).

rubrics_metrics.name: ColorPrompt(bool[, optrec]) (colorized prompts/input)
rubrics_metrics.description: ColorPrompt(true) changes the UI so prompts and user input are displayed in colors different from output (default). ColorPrompt(false) switches off these colorings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Colors only work if terminal understands ANSI color escape sequences. Use SetUserPreference('UseColorPrompt', false) in gap.ini to disable at startup or move complex optrec into gaprc. optrec may contain MarkupStdPrompt, MarkupContPrompt, MarkupBrkPrompt, MarkupInput, TextPrompt, PrePrompt — each is a string or function customizing how prompts/input are colored or a hook called before printing prompt. Example shows using PrePrompt to display time of last command.

rubrics_metrics.name: Programming language overview (reading/evaluation/printing)
rubrics_metrics.description: Expressions have an external representation (character input), reading transforms external representation to an internal representation (expression/statement) according to syntax, evaluation recursively computes values from subexpressions according to semantics, and printing creates an external representation of the resulting value.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Understanding these processes lets you predict results of inputs; reading rejects illegal external representations; internal representation is tree-like; evaluation is recursive and deterministic according to language rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Autocompleter (user preference)
rubrics_metrics.description: Set how names are filtered during tab-autocomplete: "default" (case-sensitive matching), "case-insensitive" or a record with two components filter/completer (functions taking list of names and partial identifier).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ignored if GAP was not compiled with readline support. Default: "default".

rubrics_metrics.name: Editor / EditorOptions (picker for external editor)
rubrics_metrics.description: Determines the editor and options used by GAP’s Edit command.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Under macOS, Editor := "open" will work. If you want to use the editor defined in your shell environment leave Editor and EditorOptions empty. Defaults computed at runtime.

rubrics_metrics.name: ExcludeFromAutoload (packages not autoloaded)
rubrics_metrics.description: These packages are not loaded at GAP startup. Does not work for packages needed by the GAP library or already loaded in a workspace.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Default: "" (empty).

rubrics_metrics.name: HelpViewers / XpdfOptions / XdviOptions (help display preferences)
rubrics_metrics.description: Choose preferred help viewers; values may include ["screen","firefox","xpdf"] etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If using 'screen' set Pager := 'less'. Defaults: [ ["screen"], "", "" ]. See SetHelpViewer for details.

rubrics_metrics.name: HistoryBackwardSearchSkipIdenticalEntries
rubrics_metrics.description: When a command is executed multiple times it is stored multiple times; setting this option to true skips identical entries when searching backwards in history.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Admissible values: true, false. Default: false.

rubrics_metrics.name: HistoryMaxLines / SaveAndRestoreHistory
rubrics_metrics.description: HistoryMaxLines is the maximal number of input lines held in command history. If SaveAndRestoreHistory is true GAP saves history before terminating and prepends stored history on startup.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If saving history, set HistoryMaxLines to a finite value or infinity to keep arbitrarily many lines. Ignored if GAP was not compiled with readline support. Defaults: [10000, true].

rubrics_metrics.name: InfoPackageLoadingLevel
rubrics_metrics.description: Info messages concerning package loading up to this level are printed. Level can be changed in a running session using SetInfoLevel.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Admissible values: 1,2,3,4. Default: 1.

rubrics_metrics.name: MaxBitsIntView
rubrics_metrics.description: Maximal bit length of integers to View unabbreviated. Default corresponds to about 30 lines of an 80 character terminal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Set to 0 to avoid abbreviated ints. Default: 8000.

rubrics_metrics.name: PartialPermDisplayLimit / NotationForPartialPerms
rubrics_metrics.description: Options controlling display of partial permutations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defaults: [100, "component"].

rubrics_metrics.name: TransformationDisplayLimit / NotationForTransformations
rubrics_metrics.description: Options controlling display of transformations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defaults: [100, "input"].

rubrics_metrics.name: PackagesToIgnore
rubrics_metrics.description: These packages are not regarded as available (doesn't work for packages needed by library or already loaded).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Default: "".

rubrics_metrics.name: PackagesToLoad (startup autoload list)
rubrics_metrics.description: List of names of packages which should be loaded during startup. For backwards compatibility the default lists many packages autoloaded in GAP 4.4.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Default example list provided (e.g., ["autpgrp","alnuth",...]). Modify to add/remove packages as desired.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pager / PagerOptions
rubrics_metrics.description: For displaying help pages GAP has a builtin pager; recommendation is to use an external pager like less and set Pager := "less" and PagerOptions := [ "-f", "-r", "-a", "-i", "-M", "-j2" ].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you want to use the pager from environment leave Pager and PagerOptions empty. Suggest using -f option for less.

rubrics_metrics.name: ReadObsolete
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether to read library files containing obsolete variables; may be useful to set false to check for use of commands that may vanish.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Admissible values: true, false. Default: true.

rubrics_metrics.name: ReproducibleBehaviour
rubrics_metrics.description: Disables GAP code which changes behaviour based on time spent and therefore can produce different results depending on timing. Aims to make runs reproducible on same version/machine/session.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: May lead to slower or lower-quality results. Note: global random number generator is NOT affected. Admissible values: true, false. Default: false.

rubrics_metrics.name: ShortBanners
rubrics_metrics.description: If true, package banners printed during loading will only show the name, version and description of a package.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Admissible values: true, false. Default: false.

rubrics_metrics.name: UseColorPrompt
rubrics_metrics.description: Enable colored prompts and input in a color-capable terminal. Options: true, false, or a record for customized settings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Default: true. For complex settings specify record in gaprc rather than gap.ini.

rubrics_metrics.name: UseColorsInTerminal
rubrics_metrics.description: Enable color display for manuals and other things in a terminal that supports color.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Admissible values: true, false. Default: true.

rubrics_metrics.name: ViewLength
rubrics_metrics.description: A bound for the number of lines printed when Viewing large objects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Default: 3.
